heightfield-sculpted-f32.npy.why: the sculpted base: orogeny, benching, naturalness, coastal banks

heightfield-shaped-f32.npy.why: the shaped ground the hydrology graph is solved on: terrace, detail noise, the Blackrose lake and feeders, portages, shoreline smoothing, fluvial continuum

refined-height-frozen-f32.npy.why: the frozen base: the shaped ground carved to the hydrology graph (trenches, weirs, plunge bowls, islets); patches only from here on

hydrology-graph-solution.npz.why: the channel solution the graph derive left (restored byte-identical from the carve's copy on 2026-09-16 after an accidental re-derive)

hydrology-graph-bodies.npz.why: the graph's body level and sea rasters that every patch gate and the water compile read; repaired on 2026-09-16 against the frozen graph and the compiled water after an accidental re-derive (16e ledger 2d), never re-derived; a refreeze regenerates it

about: Content hashes of the terrain arrays the province is built on. A chain stage refuses to overwrite a recorded array with different content unless ES_REFREEZE=1; see worldgen/freeze.py and decision 0059.
